fusions.name: Slipped Between Ribs
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A hidden strike that deals 22 piercing damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fan of Fangs
fusions.desc: Throws 3 venomed blades in a spread; each deals 6 piercing damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Coiled Under the Cloak
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds, moving 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Edge in the Dark
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
